## Purpose

Holds `SkillsHooksContext`, a small React context tracking which skills and hooks (from
`@/data`) the user has attached to the in-progress workflow composition. **No dependencies of
its own**; consumed by the app shell, layout, library, and workflow-composer components that
need to read or mutate the attached set.

## Shape

- [SkillsHooksContext.tsx](../../frontend/src/context/SkillsHooksContext.tsx) — `SkillsHooksProvider` holds two arrays of live state,
  `attachedSkills: AttachedSkill[]` and `attachedHooks: AttachedHook[]`, with
  `attachSkill`/`detachSkill`/`attachHook`/`detachHook` (each dedupes by id — attaching an
  already-attached item is a no-op) and `clearAll`. `useSkillsHooks()` is the consumer hook;
  it throws if called outside the provider.

## Why this shape

This is deliberately separate from `@/providers` (which owns the SSE run connection) because
it's **local UI-composition state** — what the user has picked in the composer before a run
even starts — not live-run/transport state.

It's plain `useState` + context rather than a reducer or external store because the state
shape is trivial (two small arrays) and short-lived (reset via `clearAll` once a run launches
or the composer is dismissed).
